ValidationRule.description: Validates that all required approval fields are populated before allowing changes to Operation Result field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Card_Operations_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c,"Jordan"), NOT(ISNEW()), OR( /* Credit Card Record Type */ AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Credit_Card", OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Admin_Result__c, '') ) ), /* Credit Card Cash Collateral - Regular */ AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Credit_Card_Cash_Collateral_Regular", OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Admin_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, '') ) ), /* Credit Limit Increase */ AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Credit_Limit_Increase", OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Admin_Result__c, '') ) ), /* Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase */ AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Cash_Collateral_Credit_Limit_Increase", OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Admin_Result__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, '') ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please make sure all results are submitted by the previous queues.
